summary: Comprehensive SEO/AEO/GEO validation of the Cybercity Opus static landing page. Ran 26 pytest cases covering: (1) compiled Tailwind CSS replaces CDN, (2) canonical + og:url point to opuscybercity-beige.vercel.app with no bare-domain leaks, (3) viewport meta has no maximum-scale / user-scalable=no, (4) robots.txt lists GPTBot / PerplexityBot / ClaudeBot / Google-Extended / OAI-SearchBot and correct Sitemap line, (5) sitemap.xml is valid XML with all -beige <loc>, (6) llms.txt contains required strings, (7) all 4 self-hosted images serve as image/jpeg and are referenced in HTML with no lh3.googleusercontent.com hotlinks remaining, (8) JSON-LD parses cleanly and includes Organization+WebSite+BreadcrumbList+RealEstateListing+FAQPage with full enrichment (address, geo 17.4239/78.4106, images, RERA identifier P02500004589, AggregateOffer offerCount 3 INR, org sameAs Instagram, FAQ >=12 with price-per/possession/freehold entries, 3-item breadcrumb). All 26 backend tests PASSED. Frontend Playwright checks at 1440x900 and 390x844: nav lockup (nav-konu-logo, nav-cybercity-logo, nav-project-address) visible, H1 shows OPUS + CYBERCITY, hero-location-badge shows 'ROAD NO. 45' and 'JUBILEE HILLS', ZERO console errors, ZERO horizontal overflow (client width == scroll width) on both breakpoints.

issues: Floor-plan image src/onclick paths use relative 'public/site/...' while the map image uses absolute '/public/site/location-map.jpg'. Both resolve correctly at the root path, but inconsistency could break if the page is ever mounted at a subpath. Minor / cosmetic - not blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: Consider normalising all self-hosted image paths in index.html to start with a leading slash for consistency (map uses '/public/site/...', floor-plans use 'public/site/...').

server.js has no cache headers for /dist/tailwind.css or /public/site/*.jpg - vercel.json is expected to handle prod caching but for local parity express.static could set immutable/max-age for hashed assets in future.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static express site on :3000. Pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_seo_static.py covers all SEO/AEO/GEO acceptance criteria. If HTML/CSS changes, rerun: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_seo_static.py -v. If Tailwind classes change, rebuild with: cd /app && npx tailwindcss -i ./src/tailwind-input.css -o ./dist/tailwind.css --minify. Server started with: cd /app && node server.js &. All JSON-LD (Organization, WebSite, BreadcrumbList, RealEstateListing, FAQPage) is embedded in a single <script type='application/ld+json'> block inside a top-level @graph. FAQ currently has >=12 entries; breadcrumb has 3 items.
